restaurant_name: CG Tooth to Face Dental Clinic
text:
I saw this clinic was located in front of my village, so I decided to try getting my teeth cleaned using my social security benefits. I paid an additional 60 baht for the nursing service. I had it done by a male dentist on a weekday afternoon. It was incredibly quick, the fastest I've ever had it done, around 10-15 minutes. I hadn't had my teeth cleaned in over a year, so I can't say I had very little tartar. When I got home, I could see with my own eyes that it wasn't completely clean. I don't know if it's because of the social security benefits or not. I'm giving it 1 star for the convenience of getting to the clinic.
I wasn't impressed with anything, from the counter staff when I called to make an appointment to the questions about other dental work before I left. First and last time here.
